Subject: StellarGrid - Demo plan & gating items (split-run suggested)

Hi Elena — thanks for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I want to get a short working plan on the table so we don't lose momentum while procurement/security finish their review.

Proposed plan:
- Short, recorded end-to-end walkthrough from our SE (20–25m) that covers architecture and integration points.
- Follow-up live Q&A / deep-dive with your infra/security and our SE (45m).
- Commercial/contract checklist owned by procurement (mutual action plan attached).

We had tentatively penciled a live session for Tue Nov 2. Two gating items came up: access to a sandbox (security) and final procurement approval. If either is delayed, Jasmine (our SE) is willing to record the demo and join the live deep-dive to answer questions — or we can do a screen-share where no customer-side network changes are required.

Can you confirm: who from your security/procurement should we coordinate with directly (email/contact)? If you prefer, I can split the meeting into two bookings now so calendar invites don't block each other.

Thanks — I’ll attach the SOC2 summary and mutual action plan for procurement review.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Vanessa — thanks, and apologies for the curveball.

Short version: procurement has a freeze on new vendor sandbox access until we complete a security questionnaire and obtain network/IP allowlist details. That process is with Procurement (cc’d) and Security (not cc’d here). They expect 7–10 business days for external sandbox approval unless we get an exception.

We are still very interested — the main ask is: can you provide a demo that does not require provisioning a customer-side sandbox for the first pass? Carlos (cc) is our infra lead; procurement is on the thread. If you can provide a recording + a short live Q&A, that would be ideal.

—

Thanks Vanessa / Elena — quick note from the SE side. I’m traveling for customer work Nov 1–3 and won’t be able to host a hands-on live sandbox session on Nov 2. Options I can support: 

1) I can record a 20–25 minute walkthrough this week that covers the integration flow, typical latency/cost numbers, and a live run using our public demo environment (no access needed on your side). I’ll include a narrated run and highlight where we’d request IP allowlist entries if you want to provision a sandbox later.

2) If you need a live interactive run without modifying your network, we can do a screen-share of your engineers’ questions against our hosted demo — no customer-side sandbox required.

3) If Procurement requires the SOC2 + network list to proceed, I can compile the minimal list of IPs/ports and the small sample logs you asked for; that will speed their risk assessment.

I’ve attached a short pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.md) showing what we need for a full live run vs. what we can do async. If you prefer Nov 9 for the live Q&A, I can make that work when I’m back.

- We need a completed security questionnaire (we can send our vendor form).
- Please provide your SOC2 report summary (or a SOC2 bridge letter) and an allowlist of source IPs your hosted demo uses.
- Contract and vendor onboarding typically take 7–10 business days after we receive the materials. Exceptions are rare unless Security signs off.

If you can supply the SOC2 summary and the minimal network list now, we’ll start the internal review and reasonably may be able to shorten the window. For immediate demo needs, we will accept a recorded walkthrough, but any production or pre-production access needs the above.

Appreciate the clarifications. Based on the availability and procurement timing, I recommend we split the workstreams so both sides can make progress: 

A) Immediate: we’ll send a recorded SE walkthrough (20–25m) and the pre-demo packet (IP list, short logs, SOC2 summary). This gets your product and exec teams visibility without waiting for vendor onboarding.

B) Follow-up: schedule a live deep-dive / Q&A for Nov 9 (45m) with your infra/security and our SE. If Security can unblock earlier they can convert the Nov 9 slot into a hands-on sandbox run.

Action items I’ll take today:
- Post the recording to the Google Drive folder and share the link (drive link above).
- Upload the SOC2-summary.pdf and MutualActionPlan_StellarGrid.xlsx for Procurement.
- Send a short IP/ports list and two sample logs to Carlos for Security review.

Can Procurement confirm whether receiving the SOC2-summary + IP list today will start the review? If so, we’ll aim to shorten the window.

Thanks — I’ll also propose calendar blocks for Nov 4 (recording review) and Nov 9 (deep-dive).

—
